description:
Bühler Milling Solutions is the leading specialist in state-of-the-art process technologies for producing high-quality flour and semolina products from wheat, durum, rye, and corn. To strengthen our team in the Milling Academy, we are looking for a committed, entrepreneurial-minded personality as Instructor Process Technology.

Aufgaben:
• You train customer personnel and internal employees in milling technology, both at the Milling Academy and on-site through hands-on training

• You create, update, and maintain training materials and course documentation, while continuously familiarizing yourself with new technologies and equipment

• You define and further develop course content together with the team to ensure high-quality and up-to-date training programs

• You support customers and course participants by providing professional guidance, organizing visits and representations, and ensuring a positive overall training experience

• You provide technological and administrative support to the Customer Service and Technology departments, including sales-supporting activities such as mill inspections and technical assistance in discussions

Anforderungen:
• Completed vocational training as a miller or an equivalent qualification, ideally combined with advanced technical education in milling (e.g. Swiss School of Milling, DMSB, or similar), as well as several years of practical experience in the milling industry

• Profound technical expertise in wheat, durum, oat, and corn milling, including detailed knowledge of machinery, aspiration, and pneumatics, complemented by a basic understanding of electrical and automation technology

• Willingness to travel internationally for mill inspections, customer training, and on-site support, combined with the ability to work effectively across different cultures and environments

• Independent, responsible, and motivating personality with strong teamwork skills, the ability to stay calm under pressure, and a confident and professional presence when representing the company externally

• Strong communication skills in Arabic, French and English, both written and spoken; additional languages such as German or Spanish are an advantage

Wir bieten:
Attractive vacation entitlement
Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking.

VIVA Restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Mobile phone subscriptions
We offer special conditions for cell phone subscriptions via Mobilezone with Sunrise and Swisscom.

Sports activities
We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.
